scope: Local macOS reconstructed application checks; no Windows GUI or audio endpoint acceptance and no proprietary target execution.

mac_gui.method: Native application accessibility observations and actions
observations: Bundled example opened with four tracks and eleven clips at 96 BPM.
Move Opening from 0 to 0.1 seconds, undo to 0, redo to 0.1.
Trim Opening from 5 to 4.9 seconds, undo to 5.
Play advanced the displayed playhead with nonzero output meters; pause retained position and zeroed meters.
Split Pocket at 8.746 seconds into 3.746- and 1.254-second clips; right source offset 8.746; undo and redo restored the respective states.
Delete the right split clip and undo restored it.
Change Rhythm gain from -5 to -4.5 dB and undo restored -5 dB.
Reopen the example with dirty edits: discard prompt appeared; discard restored four tracks, eleven clips, original timing/gain, zero playhead and disabled undo/redo.

limitations: These observations do not establish full Windows parity or proprietary application equivalence.
Private fixture tests are local observations; public CI uses only public controls.
The Windows native backend and Swift output fixes require a separate recorded Windows run.
